## 2026-11-19 13:05 · claude-macbook · memento

2026-11-19: M4 and M5 done and installed in the owner's pack (branch time-sweep-spike, still uncommitted).
- **M4 photo packs:** the darkroom session temporarily adds available-but-disabled Fresh Animations packs (and config photoResourcePacks) just below the player's file/ packs via PackRepository.setSelected plus reloadResourcePacks, then restores. options.txt is never touched. Chosen over a namespace "FA wrapper": FA jems reference no textures and FA overwrites vanilla textures, so hiding it would leave eyeless mobs.
- **Ghosting fix:** per-frame disparity maps (NN.d.png, half resolution) captured during the sweep. Iris-on depth readback works. A single depth map made the spot an entity left parallax as near, which showed as a ghost.
- **Sweep plan:** now ±0.5 s at 1/30 s.
- **Actors:** those blocking the camera→player line, or within 2.5 blocks of the lens, are left out.
- **M5 MomentScout:** every 2 s; raycasts only after the player has stood still for 3 s. Recipes: vista, golden_hour (camera faces the sun), portrait (max 0.85), event (advancement toast). Automatic scores are capped at 0.95, manual F7 = 1. Cooldown 180 s overall and 10 min per recipe. Queue and develop order sort by score.
- **Harness gotcha:** never press a confirm button twice. A double BackupConfirm press opened the world twice ("Lock is no longer valid").
- **Not done:** the home recipe (needs build tracking), multiplayer, commit.

## 2026-11-19 12:23 · claude-macbook · memento

M2 and M3 are done and installed in the owner's pack (2026-11-19; branch time-sweep-spike, uncommitted).
- **M2:** F7 records a moment to memento/moments/<id>.json. It holds camera, time, weather, the player, and up to 48 entities with server NBT (SNBT). At most 10 are queued.
- **M3 darkroom:** starts after the title screen is idle (darkroomIdleSeconds, default 30).
  - Copies saves/.memento-darkroom: level.dat, data/, datapacks/, and the region files near the subject only. No entities/.
  - Writes players/data/<localUuid>.dat: creative, flying, at the recorded spot.
  - Opens that world under a DarkroomOverlay.
  - Commands: gamerule spawn_mobs/spawn_monsters false, difficulty normal, time, weather.
  - Places the actors client-side, then runs ShotDirector.develop and disconnects. Harness: about 13–16 s per moment.
- **Gotchas:**
  - Minecraft.doWorldLoad waits while ANY overlay is up (DarkroomWorldLoadMixin hides ours).
  - EntityType.create refuses monsters in PEACEFUL, so load peaceful and switch to normal before placing.
  - 26.3 save layout: players/data/<uuid>.dat and dimensions/<ns>/<dim>/{region,entities,poi}.
  - Game rule ids are snake_case (spawn_mobs).
  - EntityType.byString and EntityType.PLAYER are gone; use BuiltInRegistries and instanceof Player.
  - The harness world copy must exclude session.lock while the owner plays.
- **Photo profile:** Iris.resetShaderPackOptionsOnNextReload plus cancelling Iris.tryUpdateConfigPropertiesFile while it is active. Verified that the owner's pack .txt is unchanged (sha).
- **Backups (scratchpad):** owner gallery in owner-memento-backup/, previous jar memento-m1-backup.jar.
- **Next:** M4 FA wrapper, M5 selection.

## 2026-11-18 06:13 · claude-macbook · memento

Direction change (owner, 2026-11-18): no shooting at exit or during play. Play only RECORDS moment state; a DARKROOM develops it later, when the title screen has been idle about 30 s (any key cancels). It uses a temporary copy of the SP world, actors rebuilt client-side, an Iris photo profile, and FA wrapped by Memento (FA overwrites vanilla mob textures: eyes moved to separate cubes, so "enable FA but hide its models" draws eyeless mobs). Gallery is 3–5 (default 5); exit shoot off by default (test tool only). Milestones: M1 motion playback (DONE in harness, branch time-sweep-spike, uncommitted), M2 moment record, M3 darkroom, M4 FA wrapper, M5 selection. Spec section "Revision 2026-11-18"; plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-18-memento-m1-motion-playback.md.
M1 gotchas: STB jpg writer calls back once PER BYTE (316k calls/frame). Buffer in native memory: 30 ms/frame, versus 450 ms with a channel write per callback. Util.ioPool is flooded during world close (10+ s delay), so Memento has its own writer. The still must be the sweep's center frame or the title jumps. NativeImage.read is PNG-only. TextureSetup has a 3-texture ctor; BindGroupLayouts.SAMPLER0_SAMPLER1_SAMPLER2 exists. Fade + blend share vertex z as alphaQ + 0.25 + blend/2, with a flat varying.

## 2026-11-18 04:51 · claude-macbook · memento

Time-sweep spike (branch time-sweep-spike, uncommitted, config motionSweep=false by default): owner wants the title background to be a frozen moment that "breathes" +-1 s around itself (FA mobs, shader waving), baked at exit, ping-pong played. Spike WORKS in the harness (Iris+Complementary defaults, EMF+FreshAnimations): 136 frames drawn in ~4 s, 61 kept, all hooks hit (entity age 3808, walk 3808, EMF 5984, Iris 136 = once/frame).
Hook points (26.3): EntityRenderer.createRenderState(Entity,F) RETURN -> ageInTicks += offset (new state per call). WalkAnimationState.position(F)F RETURN += speed*positionScale*offset (EMF limb_swing reads it too; guard render thread). EMF EMFMath.getAge/getTime RETURN += offset, getFrameTime HEAD -> step (EMF returns 1e-9 while paused); EMFLODHandler.isLODSkippingThisFrame -> false. Iris SystemTimeUniforms$Timer.getFrameTimeCounter/getLastFrameTime (wall-clock based, keeps running while paused, so waving alone proves nothing; check hook counter). @Pseudo + require=0 works; @Inject handlers with only the CallbackInfoReturnable arg are accepted.
Gotchas: Iris loadExternalShaderpack merges the option queue and REWRITES shaderpacks/<pack>.txt -> a photo-quality profile must suppress tryUpdateConfigPropertiesFile. Owner's pack .txt has WAVING_* false and SHADOW_QUALITY=-1 (no waving/shadows in real shots). Owner's FreshAnimations main pack is NOT enabled (only Fresh Textures + Fox Refreshed). PNG sweep frames = 193 MB/shot at 1470x898 -> needs smaller res + JPEG or similar. FA uses frame_time integrators gated by frame_counter, never is_paused.
